name: herdgate
description: A tiny, hackable gateway + web UI for herdr-core. Every herdr client — official Windows app, shepherdr, hc CLI — drives the same core terminals; herdgate is the shared window to watch and interact with all of them. ghostty-web rendering, observe mode, read-only tokens.

scripts.check: node --check server/gateway.mjs && node --check server/cores.mjs && node --check web/app.js && node --check web/terminal-helpers.js
